bio: This restaurant loves the chic style of Edo culture and values the human touch. Many sushi shops these days offer two time-limited seatings, serving only omakase set meals. However, Sushi Taichi shows the mettle of an old-fashioned sushi chef. The owner-chef’s agreeable disposition ensures him many regular customers. Above the counter is a shop curtain, while the walls feature woodblock prints depicting street stalls. If you like old-school sushi shops, Sushi Taichi is for you....
